title: 10 things you didn't know about orgasm
speaker: Mary Roach

sentences.en: Alright. I'm going to show you a couple of images from a very diverting paper in The Journal of Ultrasound in Medicine.
sentences.zh: 好吧。我将向您展示《医学超声杂志》上一篇非常有趣的论文中的几幅图像。

sentences.en: I'm going to go way out on a limb and say that it is the most diverting paper ever published in The Journal of Ultrasound in Medicine.
sentences.zh: 我可以大胆地说，这是《医学超声杂志》上发表的最有趣的论文。

sentences.en: The title is "Observations of In-Utero Masturbation."
sentences.zh: 标题是“子宫内手淫的观察”。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Okay. Now on the left you can see the hand -- that's the big arrow -- and the penis on the right. The hand hovering.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 好的。现在在左边你可以看到手——那就是大箭头——右边是阴茎。手悬空。

sentences.en: And over here we have, in the words of radiologist Israel Meisner, "The hand grasping the penis in a fashion resembling masturbation movements."
sentences.zh: 在这里，用放射科医生以色列·迈斯纳的话说，“手以类似于自慰动作的方式抓住阴茎。”

sentences.en: Bear in mind this was an ultrasound, so it would have been moving images.
sentences.zh: 请记住，这是超声波，因此它会是移动图像。

sentences.en: Orgasm is a reflex of the autonomic nervous system.
sentences.zh: 性高潮是自主神经系统的反射。

sentences.en: Now, this is the part of the nervous system that deals with the things that we don't consciously control, like digestion, heart rate and sexual arousal.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是神经系统的一部分，负责处理我们无意识控制的事情，例如消化、心率和性唤起。

sentences.en: And the orgasm reflex can be triggered by a surprisingly broad range of input.
sentences.zh: 性高潮反射可以通过令人惊讶的广泛输入范围来触发。

sentences.en: Genital stimulation. Duh. But also, Kinsey interviewed a woman who could be brought to orgasm by having someone stroke her eyebrow.

sentences.en: People with spinal cord injuries, like paraplegias, quadriplegias, will often develop a very, very sensitive area right above the level of their injury, wherever that is.
sentences.zh: 患有脊髓损伤的人，如截瘫、四肢瘫痪，通常会在受伤部位的正上方形成一个非常非常敏感的区域，无论受伤部位在哪里。

sentences.en: There is such a thing as a knee orgasm in the literature.
sentences.zh: 文献中有膝盖高潮这样的事情。

sentences.en: I think the most curious one that I came across was a case report of a woman who had an orgasm every time she brushed her teeth.
sentences.zh: 我认为我遇到的最奇怪的一个案例报告是一位女性每次刷牙时都会达到性高潮的案例报告。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Something in the complex sensory-motor action of brushing her teeth was triggering orgasm.
sentences.zh: （笑声）刷牙这种复杂的感觉运动动作中的某些东西触发了性高潮。

sentences.en: And she went to a neurologist, who was fascinated.
sentences.zh: 她去看了一位神经科医生，后者对此很着迷。

sentences.en: He checked to see if it was something in the toothpaste, but no -- it happened with any brand.
sentences.zh: 他检查了牙膏中是否有这种情况，但没有——任何品牌的牙膏都会出现这种情况。

sentences.en: They stimulated her gums with a toothpick, to see if that was doing it.
sentences.zh: 他们用牙签刺激她的牙龈，看看是否有作用。

sentences.en: No. It was the whole, you know, motion. And the amazing thing to me is that you would think this woman would have excellent oral hygiene.
sentences.zh: 不，你知道，这就是整个运动。让我惊奇的是，你会认为这个女人的口腔卫生非常好。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Sadly -- this is what it said in the journal paper -- "She believed that she was possessed by demons and switched to mouthwash for her oral care."
sentences.zh: （笑声）可悲的是——期刊论文是这样说的——“她相信自己被恶魔附身，所以改用漱口水来护理口腔。”

sentences.en: It's so sad. (Laughter) When I was working on the book, I interviewed a woman who can think herself to orgasm.
sentences.zh: 太悲伤了。 （笑声）当我写这本书时，我采访了一位可以认为自己达到性高潮的女性。

sentences.en: She was part of a study at Rutgers University.
sentences.zh: 她是罗格斯大学一项研究的一部分。

sentences.en: You've got to love that. Rutgers. So I interviewed her in Oakland, in a sushi restaurant.
sentences.zh: 你一定会喜欢的。罗格斯大学。所以我在奥克兰的一家寿司店采访了她。

sentences.en: And I said, "So, could you do it right here?"
sentences.zh: 我说：“那么，你能在这里做吗？”

sentences.en: And she said, "Yeah, but you know I'd rather finish my meal if you don't mind."
sentences.zh: 她说：“是的，但你知道，如果你不介意的话，我宁愿吃完饭。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) But afterwards, she was kind enough to demonstrate on a bench outside.
sentences.zh: （笑声）但是后来她很友善地在外面的长凳上示范了。

sentences.en: It was remarkable. It took about one minute.
sentences.zh: 这是非常了不起的。大约花了一分钟。

sentences.en: And I said to her, "Are you just doing this all the time?"
sentences.zh: 我对她说：“你一直这样做吗？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) She said, "No. Honestly, when I get home, I'm usually too tired."
sentences.zh: （笑声） 她说：“不。说实话，当我回到家时，我通常都太累了。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) She said that the last time she had done it was on the Disneyland tram.
sentences.zh: （笑声）她说她上次这样做是在迪士尼乐园的电车上。

sentences.en: (Laughter) The headquarters for orgasm, along the spinal nerve, is something called the sacral nerve root, which is back here.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 高潮的总部，沿着脊神经，是一种叫做骶神经根的东西，它就在这里。

sentences.en: And if you trigger, if you stimulate with an electrode, the precise spot, you will trigger an orgasm.
sentences.zh: 如果你触发，如果你用电极刺激精确的点，你就会触发性高潮。

sentences.en: And it is a fact that you can trigger spinal reflexes in dead people -- a certain kind of dead person, a beating-heart cadaver.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你可以触发死人的脊髓反射——某种死人，一具心脏跳动的尸体。

sentences.en: Now this is somebody who is brain-dead, legally dead, definitely checked out, but is being kept alive on a respirator, so that their organs will be oxygenated for transplantation.
sentences.zh: 现在，这个人已经脑死亡，在法律上已经死亡，肯定已经接受了检查，但仍靠呼吸器维持生命，以便他们的器官充氧以进行移植。

sentences.en: Now in one of these brain-dead people, if you trigger the right spot, you will see something every now and then.
sentences.zh: 现在，在这些脑死亡的人身上，如果你触发正确的位置，你会时不时地看到一些东西。

sentences.en: There is a reflex called the Lazarus reflex.
sentences.zh: 有一种反射叫做拉撒路反射。

sentences.en: And this is -- I'll demonstrate as best I can, not being dead.
sentences.zh: 这就是——我将尽我所能证明，我不会死。

sentences.zh: 是这样的。你触发了这个地点。死去的家伙，或者女孩，就这样走了。

sentences.en: Very unsettling for people working in pathology labs.
sentences.zh: 对于在病理实验室工作的人们来说非常令人不安。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now, if you can trigger the Lazarus reflex in a dead person, why not the orgasm reflex?
sentences.zh: （笑声）现在，如果你能在死人身上触发拉撒路反射，为什么不能触发性高潮反射呢？

sentences.en: I asked this question to a brain death expert, Stephanie Mann, who was foolish enough to return my emails.
sentences.zh: 我向脑死亡专家斯蒂芬妮·曼（Stephanie Mann）提出了这个问题，她愚蠢地回复了我的电子邮件。

sentences.zh: 她说：“是的，如果骶神经被充氧，你就可以想象。”

sentences.en: Obviously it wouldn't be as much fun for the person.
sentences.zh: 显然，这对这个人来说不会那么有趣。

sentences.en: But it would be an orgasm -- (Laughter) nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 但这将是一次高潮——（笑声）尽管如此。

sentences.en: There is a researcher at the University of Alabama who does orgasm research.

sentences.en: I said to her, "You should do an experiment.
sentences.zh: 我对她说：“你应该做一个实验。

sentences.zh: 你知道吗？如果你在大学工作，你就可以获得尸体。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) According to 1930s marriage manual author, Theodoor van De Velde, a slight seminal odor can be detected on the breath of a woman within about an hour after sexual intercourse.
sentences.zh: （笑声）根据 1930 年代婚姻手册的作者 Theodoor van De Velde 的说法，性交后大约一小时内，可以在女性的呼吸中检测到轻微的精液气味。
